structured.answer: I found where the site explains a type of saving: the box 'להבין סוג של חיסכון' leads to a guide with cards for 'פיקדון' and 'תכנית חיסכון'. But I only saw their headings and not the explanation itself, so next time I'll click straight on 'תכנית חיסכון' or ask my son to sit with me.

stuck.why: The פיקדון and תכנית חיסכון cards were cut between screens; I saw only their titles and the ends of sentences ('ריבית', 'מוסכמת בריבית'), not what they say

stuck.where: Guide page top, 'שני חלקים בכל חיסכון'
stuck.why: The idea of 'where the money is held' versus 'what it is invested in' confused me before I reached anything I knew
It isn't a bank and I didn't know who is behind it, so I hesitated about whether to trust it
English letters and indexes; I felt it wasn't for me and got tired

used: Home page box 'להבין סוג של חיסכון – מה זה, כמה זה עולה ואיך זה ממוסה'
Line 'אתר אישי, לא מסחרי, בלי קישורי שיווק'
Guide page section 'כסף שוטף וקצר' with the cards 'חשבון עובר ושב', 'פיקדון', 'תכנית חיסכון'
skimmed: The 'מה השאלה שלכם?' form with amounts and years
'מאיפה להתחיל' (קרן השתלמות, קרן חדשה מקיפה, קרן כספית)
The 'לבחירה עצמית' cards and the government bond cards
skipped: The index cards (S&P 500, MSCI, נאסד"ק, ת"א-35/90/125)
unsure_meaning: מדד (in the sense of shares, not the price index)
not_found: The actual explanation of what a פיקדון or תכנית חיסכון is (only the headings were visible)
Who runs the site: a bank or an official body
A simple comparison of deposit interest with other options

findings.what: The פיקדון and תכנית חיסכון cards, the ones I came for, got cut between screens; I saw only the headings
Small grey text on a black background is hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: The line 'בכל עמוד של מוצר יש שורה...', 'אתר אישי, לא מסחרי', and the card subtitles

findings.what: You can't tell who is behind the site; it isn't a bank or anything that looks official
Most of the guide is indexes and English letters, which tires me and makes me anxious
'קרן כספית' comes first as the place for money that has to stay available, ahead of a deposit, and I don't know that word
An abstract explanation ('שני חלקים בכל חיסכון') comes before the simple things
